offer: AI employees for finance and operations roles. A company briefs each one once, and it owns the job end to end.
ideal_customer: Enterprises and large mid-market companies with heavy accounts payable, procurement or compliance volume.
personas: Head of AP or Finance Ops

pains.signal: Hiring several AP, AR, accounting or finance ops roles
pains.pain: Volume is growing faster than the team
pains.zamp_angle: An AI employee takes the repetitive queue so new hires work on exceptions

pains.signal: ERP migration or a new finance system
pains.pain: Process redesign is underway, a window to change how work is done
pains.zamp_angle: Build the automated flow into the new system from day one

pains.signal: Expansion into new countries or entities
pains.pain: More vendors, currencies, tax rules and entities to close
pains.zamp_angle: Scale the process without scaling headcount in line

pains.pain: Finance operations must scale for the next stage

pains.signal: Compliance, audit or regulatory work in the news or on the site
pains.pain: Checks and evidence work grow with every market and product
pains.zamp_angle: An AI employee runs the checks and keeps the audit trail, so reviewers only look at exceptions

value_line: An AI employee takes the repetitive accounts payable queue, so the team's own people can work on the exceptions.
tone: Plain, peer to peer, specific. No hype words. One interest question as the call to action.
do_not: Do not name customers in a draft
Do not put ROI multipliers in a draft
Do not mention how the prospect's information was found

proof._note: Only these figures and stories may appear in a draft. Each has a public source. Add a sourced effort or hours figure under impact to use it in subjects and bodies; until then drafts use only the published figures.

impact.example: Set effortReduction to a sourced figure such as "60% fewer manual hours on invoice entry" and source to its URL.

caselets.anonymous: A finance team at a fitness and wellness software company now has Zamp handle most of its invoice processing end to end. The team only steps in when Zamp asks a question.
caselets.named: Mindbody's finance team now has Zamp handle most of its invoice processing end to end. They only step in when Zamp asks a question.

caselets.named: Wio Bank uses Zamp to automate complex operations with full compliance, so its teams can focus on the work that needs judgement.
